name: chittyos-gws
description: Google Workspace skills for chittyagent-google. The google-* skills (gmail, drive, calendar, docs, sheets, tasks) drive the chittyagent-google MCP tools and hold no credential. The gws-* and recipe-* skills are legacy, need the gws CLI on PATH, and are CLI-only: admin-reports, chat, chat-send, people, keep, events, modelarmor, script, slides, gmail forward/reply-all/watch.
